title: Programs Fixture (consolidated view of school programs / events)
description:
Schema for each pilot's programs.json. Canonical view of non-holiday non-exam school programs (e.g., school-reopens, contests, celebrations) that the C1.7 loader's `expandPrograms(pilot)` reads.

A single entry can span 1..N days (start == end for single-day programs). Multi-day programs (e.g., Saraswati Puja Magh 28-29 for the first pilot) are declared ONCE here and expanded to per-day events in calendar/*.json by C1.2 data; the C1.6 spec asserts the two views agree.

Categories: school_specific | academic — narrower than the calendar metadata.category enum because programs are operator-driven activities, not statutory holidays. Every program optionally references a `sourceTermId` linking back to academic-structure.json.

programs.description: Ordered list of programs in the AY. May be empty.

category.description: Narrower than the calendar metadata.category enum. Programs are operator-driven, not statutory; the two categories distinguish school-defined activities (contests, celebrations) from academic-track activities (mid-term review days, etc.).

endBsDate.description: Inclusive end. Single-day program: start == end. Multi-day: start < end.

sourceTermId.description: Optional. References academic-structure.json's terms[].id. Useful for term-level analytics and for the C7 result-aggregation engine that can pivot on which term a program lands in.

subcategory.description: Optional finer-grain hint for operators. Not consumed by code.
